package.name: san_nav2
package.description:
SAN v1.5 — Nav2 navigation stack integration.
Ported and adapted from skyhunter_navigation (Limon code) with fixes: 1. odom_topic standardized to /odometry/filtered (matches san_localization dual-EKF output) 2. AMCL section added (was missing in Limon) 3. Frame conventions verified (map / odom / base_footprint)
Provides Nav2 stack config for global planner + DWB controller + behavior server + collision monitor. Works with san_localization for map-frame pose, and san_reroute_planner takes over for Tier 1.5 cost-map evasion (SDD §6.4 KPP-2).
